summary: Module 12 checkpoint. A staff-only /api/stats with the five numbers, an SLI against its SLO and the votes; the .NET gateway forwards it and /api/feedback with six new tests; a React dashboard and Good/Bad votes under every answer; a real screenshot in the README with an honest caption: a rehearsal of 24 requests, a stand-in writer, estimated tokens and example prices.
goal: M12 checkpoint: a screenshot of the dashboard in the README.

items.text: Add /api/stats for staff only with the five numbers, the SLI and the votes
Forward /api/stats and /api/feedback in the gateway and see 21 tests pass
Add the votes and the dashboard to the page and run tsc and vite build
Fill the table with about 20 requests, vote in the page and open the dashboard
Take a real screenshot and write the README with what it is made of and what each number hides
Run the Python, .NET and page checks and confirm nothing got worse
Commit and push all three projects
